mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Explore = interest over time, by region and related queries/topics for your search terms (like trends.google.com/explore). Trending now = what is trending in a country right now (like trends.google.com/trending).

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to look up (Explore mode). Up to 5 are compared on one scale per Google request; with more, the actor batches them automatically and repeats the FIRST term in every batch so all terms can be put on one scale (see normalizedValue). Pick a reasonably popular first term.

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Which Google Trends data to return for each search term (Explore mode). Each term x dataset is one result. Note: Google currently often returns no related topics; such results are returned empty and not charged.

geo.title: Location (geo)
geo.description: Empty = worldwide. Otherwise a country code (US, GB, DE, IN, ...), a region (US-CA, GB-ENG) or a US metro (US-NY-501). Trending now needs a country code.

timeframe.title: Timeframe
timeframe.description: Time range. Choose Custom and set start/end date for any range since 2004. Google picks the granularity: minutes for 1-4 hours, hourly for up to 7 days, daily up to ~9 months, weekly up to 5 years, monthly beyond.

startDate.title: Start date (custom timeframe)
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH for hourly data over at most 7 days. Setting it switches the timeframe to custom.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category ID (0 = all). Top-level: 3 Arts & Entertainment, 47 Autos & Vehicles, 44 Beauty & Fitness, 22 Books, 12 Business & Industrial, 5 Computers & Electronics, 7 Finance, 71 Food & Drink, 8 Games, 45 Health, 65 Hobbies, 11 Home & Garden, 13 Internet & Telecom, 958 Jobs & Education, 19 Law & Government, 16 News, 299 Online Communities, 14 People & Society, 66 Pets, 29 Real Estate, 533 Reference, 174 Science, 18 Shopping, 20 Sports, 67 Travel. Sub-category IDs: cat= in Trends URLs.

regionResolution.title: Region resolution
regionResolution.description: Level of the interest-by-region breakdown. Auto = countries for worldwide, sub-regions (states) for a country. DMA (metro areas) is US only.

includeLowVolumeRegions.title: Include low-volume regions
includeLowVolumeRegions.description: Also return regions where Google has too little data (value 0, hasData false).

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language (hl), e.g. en-US, de, fr, ja. Affects region names, topic titles and date labels.

trendingHours.title: Trending now: time window
trendingHours.description: Trending searches started in the past N hours (Trending now mode).

maxTrendingSearches.title: Trending now: max results
maxTrendingSearches.description: Stop after this many trending searches (Trending now mode). Each is one result.

onlyNew.title: Only new trending searches (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Trending now only: return only trending searches not returned by an earlier run for the same country. Schedule the actor (e.g. every few hours) for new-trend alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new searches. Ignored in Explore mode. State is kept in the key-value store "google-trends-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Google Trends rate-limits IP addresses after a handful of requests. Apify Proxy is strongly recommended; the actor switches to a new IP whenever Google returns 429.
